Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI): Consume, analyze, and operationalize intelligence feeds to profile threat actors, track campaigns, and integrate IOCs into the detection pipeline. Detection Engineering & Tuning: Develop, test, and tune custom detection rules to reduce false positives and improve client security posture. Client Communication & Reporting: Draft detailed incident reports and threat briefings. Communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical client stakeholders. Forensics & Analysis: Perform basic to intermediate digital forensics and malware analysis (e.g., static/dynamic analysis of suspicious binaries) to determine the scope and impact of an intrusion. Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to handle client-facing interactions professionally during high-stress situations. Scripting experience (e.g., Python, PowerShell) for task automation or API integration. Familiarity with major cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and associated security telemetry.
